source_detail: Distributions table embedded in the product page HTML as HTML-escaped JSON in the componentprops attribute of <walrus-render-on-client> under <div data-componentname="PerformanceV3">; path containersByNameMap.distributions.subContainersByNameMap.table.dataPointsByNameMap
fetch_method: python requests GET (sandboxed; no sandbox bypass needed), User-Agent Chrome/126 desktop
parsing_notes: amount = totalDistribution as published by iShares. For the 41 rows with incomeAmount populated, totalDistribution equals incomeAmount+shortTermCapitalGain+longTermCapitalGain+returnOnCapital exactly (max abs diff 0.00e+00). incomeAmount is null in the source for the 5 oldest rows (ex-dates 2001-10-02, 2001-12-24, 2002-12-23, 2003-12-22, 2004-12-23) while totalDistribution is populated; totalDistribution used. All ST/LT capital-gain and return-of-capital fields are 0.0 for every row; no reinvested/undistributed capital-gain column exists in the source. No stock-split rows exist in this table. All 46 ex-dates are unique; 0 rows merged by ex-date-sum. Two distinct December 2021 distributions (ex 2021-12-13 and 2021-12-30) are kept as separate records. Coverage: fund inception 2001-08-14; first ex-date 2001-10-02; last ex-date 2026-06-15 (<= 2026-07-17 cutoff). Guessed download endpoints (<page>/1467271812596.ajax?fileType=csv|xls&fileName=EFA_distributions&dataType=fund, ?tab=distributions&fileType=json|csv) returned HTTP 200 but the product HTML page, not data; <page>/latest-distributions.csv and <page>/distributions.csv returned 404. Record dates are present in the source but not written to the CSV.
gaps: Issuer table shows December-only ex-dates for 2002-2007 (no June distribution those years); this is the issuer's published record, not a fetch gap, but it means the 'semiannual' pattern only starts 2008-06-25.
